programs.name: MIT MITES Semester

programs.name: MIT MOSTEC (Online STEM)
programs.award: free 6-month online STEM program with MIT mentors
programs.eligibility: HS juniors, underrepresented in STEM

programs.name: COSMOS (UC System Summer Program)

programs.name: CMU SAMS (Summer Academy for Math and Science)

programs.name: Summer Science Program (SSP)

programs.eligibility: HS students completing junior year, strong math required
